conversations.title: Catering menu for the library fundraiser

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: I need a catering menu for 60 people, library fundraiser, budget is tight

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: A buffet works best for 60 on a tight budget: sandwich platters, a hot pasta tray, salad, and lemonade.

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: How many sandwich platters for 60 guests?

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: Plan on 3 large sandwich platters, about 90 pieces total, plus one vegetarian platter.

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: Can we add a dessert table? Brownies and fruit?

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: Yes, brownies are cheap per head. A fruit tray adds colour and covers dietary needs.

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: What about coffee service for the evening?

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: One urn for 60 covers it. Add decaf if the event runs past 8pm.

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: Okay, send me the final menu and the price per head

messages.conversation: Catering menu for the library fundraiser
messages.text: Sandwich platters, pasta tray, salad, brownies, fruit, coffee: about $11 per head, $660 total.

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: There's a leak in the roof right above the kitchen, water coming through the ceiling

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: Put a bucket under it and move anything electric away. Call a roofer before the next rain.

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: How do I know if the ceiling is going to collapse?

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: If the plaster is sagging or bulging, stay out from under it. A small drip is usually a cracked tile or failed flashing.

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: The roofer said the flashing around the chimney is gone

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: That matches a leak near a chimney. Replacing flashing and a few tiles should fix it.

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: He quoted me for the repair, is it worth getting a second quote?

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: For a small flashing job, one trusted quote is fine. Get it in writing with the warranty.

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: What do I do about the damp patch on the wall?

messages.conversation: Roof leak over the kitchen
messages.text: Let it dry fully after the repair, then repaint with a stain-blocking primer.

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: A client hasn't paid their invoice and it's 3 weeks overdue, what do I say?

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: Keep it short and friendly: restate the amount, the due date, and ask when you can expect payment.

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: Can you draft that email for me?

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: Sure: 'Hi, just a quick note — invoice 0041 for $480 was due Nov 12. Could you let me know when payment is on its way? Thanks!'

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: What if they still don't pay?

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: Send one firmer reminder, then offer a payment plan or pause further work until the balance is settled.

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: How do I keep track of who owes what?

messages.conversation: Chasing an unpaid invoice
messages.text: A simple sheet works: client, invoice number, amount, due date, paid or unpaid.

conversations.title: Client unhappy about a late delivery

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: A client says their catering order arrived 40 minutes late and the food was cold

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: Apologise first, don't argue the clock. Offer a partial refund or a discount on the next order.

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: They want a full refund, is that fair?

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: If the food was late and cold, a full refund of the delivery fee is fair; a full refund of the whole order is generous but ends the dispute.

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: How do I stop it happening again?

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: Leave 30 minutes of buffer on every delivery and confirm the client's address the day before.

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: Draft me a reply to the client

messages.conversation: Client unhappy about a late delivery
messages.text: 'I'm really sorry the order arrived late and cold. That's not the standard we aim for. I'd like to refund the delivery fee and offer 10% off your next order.'
